version: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act 1996

rules.title: PHI access controls
rules.description: Access to Protected Health Information must be restricted to authorized personnel only with role-based access controls.
rules.required_clause: Role-based access controls for PHI must be documented and enforced.

rules.title: Encryption of PHI in transit
rules.description: All Protected Health Information transmitted electronically must be encrypted using industry-standard protocols.
rules.required_clause: Encryption standards for PHI transmission must be specified.

rules.title: HIPAA breach notification rule
rules.description: Covered entities must notify affected individuals within 60 days of discovering a PHI breach.
rules.required_clause: A 60-day breach notification procedure for PHI must be documented.

rules.title: Audit logs for PHI access
rules.description: Systems handling PHI must implement hardware, software, and procedural mechanisms to record and examine access.
rules.required_clause: Audit logging mechanisms for all PHI access must be in place.

rules.title: Business Associate Agreements
rules.description: Covered entities must have signed Business Associate Agreements with all vendors who handle PHI.
rules.required_clause: Business Associate Agreements must be in place with all PHI-handling vendors.
